title: People who frequently use ChatGPT for writing tasks are accurate and robust detectors of AI-generated text

live_model.evidence: "Detector LLM: O1-2024-12-17 ... ZERO-SHOT+ COT 83.3(6.7) 53.3(3.3) 96.7(3.3) 20(3.3) 16.7(3.3) 54(4)" (Table 2, section C, prompt-based detectors)

prompt.location: Table 19 (zero-shot detector) and Table 20 (zero-shot + CoT detector) prompt templates
prompt.note: Guide-augmented variants use Table 11 (truncated) plus the released guidebook.

claim.metric: TPR (FPR) of the zero-shot+CoT prompt-based detector, overall
claim.location: Table 2, section (C), Detector LLM O1-2024-12-17, row Zero-shot + CoT, column Overall

notes: Main results are expert human annotators (not the chosen claim). o1-pro article generation used the ChatGPT Pro interface (webui) but the generated articles are released, so the detector claim does not depend on it. The paper's 'overall' for plain zero-shot (42.2) is inconsistent with its per-column values; the CoT row (54.0) is consistent. o1 run with reasoning effort 'medium', temperature fixed at 1 by the API.
